_meta.source: MOE PSE pages for JC and MI, polytechnic, PFP, ITE 2 year and 3 year Higher Nitec, with their grade mapping tables and worked examples; SEAB SEC page
_meta.notes: Confirmed rows were read in full from the primary MOE and SEAB pages on 2026-11-11 (research/pse.md). G3 and G2 points equal the grade number, as MOE's 2028 worked examples show. Two things stay provisional because MOE does not state them: what counts as a G3 pass for a fifth year, and what applies to a student with no Mother Tongue grade. Bonus points are not taken off here. Grades entered here are the student's own hypothetical targets, for planning and goal setting. They are never a prediction.

mapDown.note: A G3 grade counts at its G2 or G1 equivalent where a score is read at that level. There is no mapping upwards.

aggregates.name: L1R4
aggregates.plain: English or Higher Mother Tongue, a Humanities, a Mathematics or Science, one more of these, and one other, all at G3. Art, Music and Economics count only as the other subject.

dests.note: A missed grade floor can still be a conditional admission.
A missed grade floor can still be a conditional admission.

aggregates.bonus: Bonus points come off for posting only. The cap is 3, plus 2 for a Language Elective Programme place. Mother Tongue is read too. Ask your school if you do not take it.

floors.label: English at G3, C6 or better
Mathematics or Additional Mathematics at G3, D7 or better
Mother Tongue at D7 (G3), 5 (G2) or D (G1), or Higher Mother Tongue at E8
floors.note: The grades are confirmed. MOE lists Mother Tongue, or an approved language in its place, as a required subject and does not say what applies to a student without one. With no Mother Tongue grade entered, this floor is left unchecked. Confirm with the school.

aggregates.conditionalNote: Conditional admission, from the 2028 PSE. With a floor grade missed: JC at L1R4 12 or better, or 13 to 16 with A1 or A2 in all four R subjects; MI at 15 or better, or 16 to 20 likewise. The grade must be reached by the end of Year 1. An Absent grade does not qualify. The engine applies it only where the subject was sat at a level the floor reads.

aggregates.name: ELR2B2
aggregates.plain: English, two relevant subjects and your best other at G3, plus a fifth subject at its G2 value.
aggregates.bonus: CCA points, up to 2, come off before the 22 is read. They are not taken off here. Each course counts different relevant subjects; this uses your best ones.

aggregates.name: ELMAB3 at G2 value
aggregates.plain: English, Mathematics and your best three others, each at its G2 value. G1 subjects are not counted.

mins.label: English 3, Mathematics 3, a relevant subject 3 and two others 4 or better, at G2 grades

dests.note: G2 grades 5 and 6, and a G3 9, cannot count.
Every G2 and G3 grade can count. Each course also sets minimum grades.
Only with 2 or fewer G3 passes. With 3 or more, the score is not needed. Each grade counted must be 5 or better.

aggregates.bonus: The 12, 19 and 21 are read before bonus points. CCA points, up to 2, then come off for PFP and Higher Nitec posting.

excluded.note: Polytechnic and PFP scores cannot use these grades. ITE scores can use a G3 9 and a G2 5 or 6. A G3 9, a G2 6 or a G1 E cannot meet an ITE course's subject minimum.
